part.text:
Fixed in `src/PhpSpreadsheet/ReferenceHelper.php`. Two bugs in the column-removal path of `insertNewBefore`:

1. **Line 465**: The guard `$beforeColumn - 2 + $numberOfColumns > 0` was off by one, so the "clear column strips" step (which nulls out cells in the columns being removed) was skipped entirely when removing a single column — stale values like `b2` survived and shifted into the wrong column. Corrected to `$beforeColumn + $numberOfColumns > 0`, which ensures the removed strip starts at/after column A.
2. **Line 1083**: `clearColumnStrips` looped only to `$highestRow - 1`, leaving cells in the last row of the removed columns uncleared. Now loops to `$highestRow`.

Verified:
- The issue repro now yields `a1, c1, d1 / a2, null, d2`
- All 57 tests in `WorksheetTest`, `ReferenceHelperTest`, `RemoveTest`, `Worksheet2Test` pass (including the previously failing `testRemoveColumnShiftsCorrectColumnValueIntoRemovedColumnCoordinates` and the `Data includes nulls` provider case)
- `Worksheet`, `Collection`, and `Functional` suites pass except 2 pre-existing `MemoryDrawingTest` errors (confirmed failing without my change — environment/GD issue)
